resources.string: Module reported by X: %1$s. If it differs from this app, embed this APK again.

Install and open this APK to manage rules, then embed the same APK into X using FPA and restart X. Changes sync within about 5 seconds while connected. Updating the settings app alone does not update the embedded module: patch X again. System UI hooks are unavailable in this edition. Live notifications depend on system permissions.
